hero.subtitle: Explore MBBS Opportunities in Uzbekistan 2026–2027. Fast-growing Central Asian destination with 100% English medium instruction, safe hostels, and modern clinics.

overview: Uzbekistan has emerged as a top choice for Indian students due to its short 3-hour flight from Delhi, affordable cost of living, and high-quality government medical institutes in Tashkent, Samarkand, and Bukhara.

faq.question: Is MBBS in Uzbekistan valid for Indian students?
faq.answer: Yes, MBBS from NMC & WHO recognized universities in Uzbekistan is fully valid in India upon passing the NExT/FMGE licensing examination.

faq.question: What is the flight time between India and Uzbekistan?
faq.answer: Direct flights from New Delhi to Tashkent take only about 3 hours, making travel very convenient for students and parents.
